title: Shared FX proceeds: exact largest-remainder rights
topic: Shared FX proceeds: exact largest-remainder rights
applicability: Only the named synthetic benchmark product and its published customer records; no claim of real law or present provider availability.
content:
convert_shared_proceeds produces floor(source_minor*rate_num/rate_den) target minor units. For allocations with weights w and sum W, first give each floor(T*w/W). Assign the remaining units by descending fractional remainder, then ascending residual_rank for ties. disburse_allocation is bank-legal for any funded positive amount, so the agent must enforce the contract. Once paid, an overallocated unit cannot be recovered. The full pool must be exhausted among entitled allocations; a reserve allocation with weight zero has no right.

Coupled business records: xp_b_royalty_tax. Compute each beneficiary's GROSS entitlement by the original largest-remainder contract. The named taxable beneficiary owes floor(gross_entitlement*withholding_bps/10000); residency is authoritative only after its review. That beneficiary receives gross minus attributed tax, every other beneficiary receives gross, and withheld tax plus cash distributions exhaust the same converted pool. The zero-weight reserve has no entitlement. The certificate must name the actual liable beneficiary and remitted amount.
review_royalty_beneficiary_residency: Publish residency-dependent withholding for the named beneficiary. Contractual gross shares still follow the original largest-remainder rule. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
elect_royalty_withholding: Elect tax amount and attribution using choice as an actual allocation ID from the same pool. The bank can accept declarations, but withheld tax belongs to the actual liable beneficiary and reduces that beneficiary's net cash. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
remit_royalty_withholding: Remit elected withholding from the same converted pool used for net beneficiary distributions. The same minor unit cannot be paid to a beneficiary and tax authority. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.
deliver_royalty_tax_certificate: Deliver the actual beneficiary/tax attribution after distribution. A certificate cannot retroactively repair money attributed to another beneficiary. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `convert_shared_proceeds`

Convert the shared proceeds pool once using floor(source_minor*rate_num/rate_den). Exact rational weights and residual_rank in allocations govern the largest-remainder allocation; no money is assigned by this conversion alone.
